The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} distills substances into extracts for use in [[alchemy]].  A substance cannot be processed in the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} until it has been researched at the [[study table]]. After, it lists decomposition products and anything that lists an essence as one of its decomposition products and can be processed in the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}. Using the Distillation Cube II yields more material than Tier 1 and is considerably faster.
